name: Bilgi Eksikliği / Ön Hazırlık Yokluğu
name_en: Knowledge Gaps / Lack of Prior Preparation
definition: Canlı ortama girerken konuya, bağlama veya '2'den 1'ini' (tanıma + yol/cevap) bilmeden girmek. Olay gelince sıfırdan düşünmek zorunda kalma.

mechanisms.primary: Missing schema / mental model — working memory must encode from scratch
secondary: Domain knowledge deficit increases processing time (SciDirect)
Observer mode instead of participant mode (Endsley SA Level 1 failure)
Chunking not established — each element processed individually (Miller, 1956)
mechanisms.key_insight: 2'den 1'i yeterli: Tanıma (bu ne tür durum) VEYA Yol (nereden bakılır) VEYA Cevap

research_sources.finding: Advance organizers: relevant subsuming concepts introduced BEFORE learning. Activates schema, reduces WM load, improves recall.
Prior knowledge activation effectiveness depends on learner level. Mobilisation (broad) for novices; perspective-taking (schema) for advanced.
Relevant prior knowledge activation via warm-up videos → better learning than irrelevant activation.
Activating SOME relevant knowledge (not all) prepares students for instruction. Benefits all prior knowledge levels.
Pre-training reduces intrinsic cognitive load for novices. Adaptive pre-training based on prior knowledge level.
Situation Awareness: mental models help overcome WM limits. SA = perception + comprehension + projection.
Experts act fast because pattern is pre-loaded in LTM. Recognition → action without deliberation. Experience = pattern library.
Recognition training can hasten expertise. Deliberate practice on recognition skills, not just knowledge accumulation.
Rich domain knowledge: increases processing speed, enables chunking, reduces need for strategy activation.
Long-term working memory: experts acquire domain-specific skills to expand WM by storing info in LTM in accessible form.
Template theory: experts have high-level schemas with variable slots. ~50,000 chunks for chess master level.
Training SA through pattern recognition: task-relevant cues only → better performance than full environment training.
SA ability + cognitive skills training in complex real-world tasks improves performance.
Supplying relevant prior knowledge eases processing. Pre-training particularly beneficial for low prior knowledge learners.
Prior knowledge activation mitigates extraneous cognitive load and optimizes learning efficiency.
Categorical framework pre-training helps overcome incorrect prior knowledge. Reduces cognitive overload.
Perceptual-cognitive skills trainable: situation awareness, anticipatory skills. Video occlusion, guided discovery effective.
SA training (perceive → recognize → predict) reduces errors and improves performance. Randomized controlled trial.
II pre-loads cue-response in memory BEFORE event. Mental representation of situation becomes highly accessible.
Including situational cues in thought about intended actions increases implementation success via S-R learning.
Deliberate practice improves performance for WHOLLY practiced scenarios. Part-practiced: assessment errors vs action errors.
Schema help orient faster and decide best response. More comprehensive schema = greater expertise. OODA loop.

solutions.name: 5 Dakikalık Ön Yükleme
solutions.evidence: STRONG — advance organizers, prior knowledge activation
solutions.protocol: Her ortama girmeden: son 10 mesaj/duyuru oku, açık konuları not et, 2'den 1'ini kontrol et (tanıma + yol)

domains.site_grup: Aidat durumu, liste nerede, son duyurular (1 dk)
domains.ders: Konu başlığı, 3 anahtar kelime, 1 şema (2 dk)
domains.sosyal: Kimler, muhtemel konular, 1 hazır cümle (1 dk)

solutions.name: Kalıp Kartları
solutions.protocol: Tekrar eden durumlar için: TETİK → EYLEM → ÖN BİLGİ. Ör: 'Aidat soruldu → WhatsApp listesine bak → Liste X grubunda'
solutions.time_to_effect: 1 week per pattern, 2 weeks for 5 patterns

solutions.name: 2'den 1'i Kuralı
solutions.protocol: Her konu için: (A) Cevabı biliyorum VEYA (B) Yolu biliyorum. Biri yoksa → 30 sn hazırlık.

solutions.name: Sohbet Radarı
solutions.protocol: Sohbet ederken iç ses: 'Bundan sonra ne sorulacak?' Aidat denildi → 'Kim ödedi?' gelir.

solutions.name: Geç Kaldım Defteri → Kalıp
solutions.protocol: Akşam: hangi bilgi eksikti? → yarın için kalıp kartı ekle.

solutions.name: Domain Mini-Şemalar
solutions.protocol: Her alan için 1 sayfa şema: ana kavramlar, bağlantılar, 'ne zaman ne yapılır'

solutions.name: If-Then + Ön Bilgi Birleşimi
solutions.protocol: If-then plan yazarken ön bilgiyi de ekle: 'Aidat sorulursa → liste WhatsApp X'te → bakıyorum'

level_0.name: Hiçbiri
level_0.description: Ne olduğunu bilmiyorum, ne yapacağımı bilmiyorum

daily_protocol.before_each_context: 30-60 sn tarama: son mesajlar, açık konular, 2'den 1'i kontrol
daily_protocol.morning: Bugünkü ortamları listele + her biri için mini ön yükleme planı
daily_protocol.evening: Hangi bilgi eksikti? → 1 kalıp kartı ekle

weekly: Kaç ortama ön yükleme yaptın / kaç ortama girdin (hedef: >80%)

interactions.note: Bilgi eksikliği düşünmeyi tetikler. Ön yükleme = en hızlı kazanım.
